title: Open Civic Agenda - Meeting
description: A schema for municipal meeting agendas, minutes, and related records. Designed for flat-file storage, backup, migration, and interchange between systems. Uses OCD-style identifiers and Popolo-compatible field names where applicable. Files are fully self-contained — no external references need to be resolved to understand or import a record. Field names are mapped to schema.org (GovernmentEvent) and Dublin Core (dcterms) via an optional JSON-LD @context — include the context to enable linked-data interoperability.

@context.description: JSON-LD context for standards interoperability. When included, consumers can interpret this document as linked data with fields mapped to schema.org and Dublin Core terms. Use the published context URL or inline the context object.

@type.description: JSON-LD type. When @context is present, this declares the schema.org type for this record.

id.description: Primary identifier for this meeting. OCD format recommended: ocd-event/{uuid}. See spec guidance on identifier conventions.

identifiers.description: Alternate identifiers for this meeting in other systems (Legistar event IDs, Granicus clip IDs, etc.).

organization.description: The body holding the meeting. Can be a simple name string or a structured object. Structured form with a stable identifier is RECOMMENDED for interchange.

id.description: Stable identifier. Deterministic path format recommended: {jurisdiction-id}/body/{slug}

jurisdiction.description: The governing jurisdiction. Structured form with OCD jurisdiction path is RECOMMENDED for interchange.

id.description: OCD jurisdiction path. This format is deterministic — any producer can generate the same ID independently.

identifiers.description: Alternate identifiers — FIPS codes, Census GEOIDs, etc.

start_date.description: When the meeting is scheduled to begin. ISO 8601 datetime with timezone, or date-only if time is unknown.

end_date.description: When the meeting ended or is expected to end. Same format as start_date.

status.description: 'continued' indicates the meeting was adjourned and will resume at a later date.

location.description: Where the meeting takes place. All fields optional to handle virtual, hybrid, and TBD situations.

url.description: Virtual meeting link (Zoom, etc.) or venue webpage.

agenda_items.description: The ordered list of agenda items. Items can nest arbitrarily via the 'items' field.

participants.description: People involved in the meeting (members, staff, presenters, public speakers).

documents.description: Meeting-level documents (the full agenda PDF, minutes, meeting packet, etc.).

media.description: Audio/video recordings of the meeting. Each item can be referenced from agenda items via 'media_ref'. For meetings with a single recording, a one-element array is fine.

id.description: Local identifier for referencing this media from agenda items. Only needs to be unique within this file. Defaults to array index if omitted.

duration_seconds.description: Total duration of the recording in seconds, if known.

label.description: Human-readable label to distinguish multiple recordings.

local_path.description: Relative path to a locally-downloaded copy of this recording. Relative to the directory containing this JSON file. Only present when files have been downloaded.

captions.description: Caption/subtitle file for this recording (VTT, SRT, etc.).

local_path.description: Relative path to a locally-downloaded copy of this caption file.

related_meetings.description: References to other meetings related to this one — joint sessions, continued meetings, breakout sessions, etc. Concurrent sessions (breakout rooms, parallel committee hearings) should be modeled as separate meeting files that reference each other here.

id.description: Primary identifier of the related meeting.

start_date.description: Start date of the related meeting, for context without needing to resolve the reference.

sources.description: Where this data came from. Important for scraped/aggregated data.

description.description: A brief summary of the meeting — what was covered, key decisions, or the stated purpose. Maps to schema:description and dcterms:description.

license.description: License or rights statement for this record. Use a SPDX identifier or URL. Maps to dcterms:license and schema:license.

extras.description: Grab bag for jurisdiction-specific or experimental fields. Use this rather than polluting the top level.

updated_at.description: When this record was last modified.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the document conforms to.

identifiers.description: Alternate identifiers for this entity in other systems. Enables cross-system matching without requiring a single canonical ID authority. The 'scheme' field is a namespace (use lowercase slugs, colon-scoped for system-specific schemes like 'legistar:millfield'). The 'identifier' field is the value within that namespace.

scheme.description: Namespace or system that issued this identifier. Use consistent lowercase slugs. Scoped schemes use colon separators.

identifier.description: The identifier value within the given scheme.

person_ref.description: A reference to a person. Fully denormalized — includes all information needed to understand who this is without resolving external references. Identifiers enable cross-system matching on import.

id.description: Primary identifier. OCD person ID if available.

present.description: Whether this person attended. Null/absent if unknown.

agenda_item.description: A single agenda item. Can nest via 'items' for sub-items (consent calendar entries, subsections, etc.).

order.description: Position in the agenda. String to allow '4.a.ii' style numbering as published.

title.description: The agenda item title as it appears on the published agenda.

description.description: Longer description or staff summary if available.

classification.description: What kind of agenda item this is.

result.description: Outcome of this item, if any. Added after the meeting or during minutes creation.

documents.description: Staff reports, attachments, proposed ordinances, etc. specific to this item.

speakers.description: People who spoke on this item (public commenters, presenters).

related_items.description: References to legislation, ordinances, resolutions, or other agenda items.

media_ref.description: Links this agenda item to a point or span in a meeting recording. Enables deep-linking into video/audio.

media_id.description: The 'id' of the media item in the meeting's media array. If omitted, refers to the first media item.

offset_seconds.description: Start point in the recording, in seconds from the beginning.

end_offset_seconds.description: End point in the recording, if a span is known.

result.description: The outcome of an agenda item — a vote, a decision to table, etc.

counts.description: Vote tallies. Keys are the option names.

votes.description: Individual votes for roll call votes.

note.description: Any additional context — 'Item was tabled to April 5 meeting', etc.

related_item_ref.description: A reference to legislation, an ordinance, resolution, or another meeting/agenda item.

id.description: Primary identifier. OCD bill ID if available.

identifier.description: Human-readable number as used by the jurisdiction.

title.description: Title of the related item if known.

document.description: An attached or related document. At minimum, include a title. URL may be unavailable for documents that are behind auth, not yet published, or where the link has gone dead.

local_path.description: Relative path to a locally-downloaded copy of this document. Relative to the directory containing this JSON file. Only present when files have been downloaded.
